 How to watch Knicks vs Raptors
 Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026
 Time: 7:30 PM ET
 Channel: MSG
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Knicks enter the matchup fresh off a thrilling 112-108 overtime victory over Toronto on Sunday, overcoming a 13-point fourth-quarter deficit to secure their 14th consecutive win against the Raptors. Jalen Brunson led the comeback with 28 points and nine assists, including a crucial three-pointer in overtime, while Karl-Anthony Towns added 28 points and 17 rebounds. New York improved to 7-6 with the victory and will look to build momentum behind its star duo.
 Toronto will be eager for revenge after letting Sunday's game slip away despite an impressive performance from Scottie Barnes. The All-Star forward returned from a four-game absence to score 30 points and grab nine rebounds, while Jamal Shead contributed 19 points off the bench. The Raptors have now lost four straight games, falling to 5-8, and will need a stronger finish to snap their lengthy losing streak against New York.
